snapshot.text: Flughafen Wien, the Vienna airport group, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}} in FY2025, but the year carried one-off write-offs from the abandoned third runway project and the deconsolidation of the Get2 security subsidiary.

Personnel expenses rose on collective wage increases and additions to personnel provisions, which weighed on the cost base against the revenue growth.
